criteria.criterion: Docker installer can mount host Codex home so Docker API sees Desktop projects and sessions.
Docker compose commands include infra/docker-compose.codex-desktop.yml when HAPPYTG_HOST_CODEX_HOME points to a readable host .codex directory.
Docker compose commands do not include the Codex Desktop projection override when no readable host Codex home is available.
Host-proxy compose override remains explicit opt-in.
Finalization and next-step commands render the same override files used by docker args.
Existing Docker isolated/reuse installer behavior remains covered.
